source: 809 Additive
target: 809 Additio

source: In the dense fog, Lumian stared at the oil lamp, feeling an urge to light it and see what would happen.
target: In nebula densa, Lumian lampam olei intuebatur, desiderium illam accendere et quid eveniret videre sentiens.

source: Eventually, he controlled himself and refrained from taking the risk.
target: Tandem se temperavit et periculum capere abstinuit.

source: With everything still in a state of chaos and uncertainty, Lumian believed that making any high‐risk decisions would be unwise.
target: Cum omnia adhuc in statu chaos et incertitudinis erant, Lumian existimavit consilia altissimo periculo instituta insipientia esse.

source: He also had no intention of taking the oil lamp to trade with Albus Medici for the head of the Abscessed Hand.
target: Etiam non habebat consilium lampam olei ferre ad commercium cum Albus Medici pro capite Manus Abscessae.

source: Since the Iron and Blood Cross Order placed the oil lamp here without guarding it, they probably weren’t worried about losing it or had many similar lamps.
target: Cum Ordo Crucis Ferri et Sanguinis lampam olei hic posuerit sine custodia, forsan non sollicitabantur de eius amissione aut multas lampadas similes haberent.

source: Based on his observations, Lumian deduced that the pale yellow grease in the lamp likely didn’t come from Iron‐blooded Knights and Demonesses of Despair.
target: Ex observationibus suis, Lumian concludit quod unguentum pallide luteum in lampade verisimiliter non ex equitibus ferri et sanguinis nec daemonissis desperationis proveniret.

source: It was different from corpse wax candles and seemed to be a mixture of mid‐sequence Hunters and Demonesses.
target: Id differebat ab candelis ex cera cadaverum et videbatur fuisse mixtura venatorum ordinis mediocris atque daemonissarum.

source: Though it’s less effective than a corpse wax candle, it should still work in the underground of Morora, which is similar to Fourth Epoch Trier…
target: Quamquam minus efficax quam candela ex cera cadaverum, tamen in subterranis partibus Morora, quae similem habet Trier Quartae Aevi, operari debet.

source: Lumian reached into his Traveler’s Bag.
target: Lumian manum in sacculum viatoris introduxit.

source: Just because he couldn’t light it or take it didn’t mean he couldn’t do anything.
target: Quod eam non incendere nec portare posset, non significabat se nihil agere posse.

source: He planned to add something extra to the oil lamp, ensuring the Iron and Blood Cross Order would face unforeseen complications during their rituals!
target: Consilium cepit aliquid addere lampae olei, ut Ordo Crucis Ferri et Sanguinis in ritibus suis inopinatas difficultates subirent!

source: Lumian took out some old blood powder from the Demon Warlock, Ice Lemon Fish fillets, a Berserk Agent from the Nightstalkers, and another Bark Agent from the same source.
target: Lumian extraxit aliquod pulverem veterem sanguinis a Daemonum Warlock, fileta piscis “Ice Lemon”, agentem ferocissimum ex Nocturnis Venatoribus, atque alium agentem ex cortice eodem fonte.

source: He placed them on the half‐height stone platform, mixed a bit of each into a brown lump the size of a human finger joint.
target: Illos posuit in suggestu lapideo dimidio altitudinis, miscens paulum ex unoquoque in globulum fuscum, magnitudine unius articulationis digiti humani.

source: What do you call this? A cocktail!
target: Quid hoc appellas? Cocktailum!

source: Lumian chuckled, putting all the materials back into his Traveler’s Bag.
target: Lumian subridens omnes materias in sacculum viatoris reponit.

source: He then took out Mr. K’s finger, sliced off some flesh, and wrapped it around the brown lump.
target: Deinde extraxit digitum Domini K, aliquam carnem secans, et circum nodule fuscum involvit.

source: This was a precaution against the Iron and Blood Cross Order’s inspection – Hunters from the Order would undoubtedly check the oil lamp for any issues before use, as it wasn’t always under their strict watch.
target: Hoc fuit cautio contra inspectionem Ordinis Crucis Ferri et Sanguinis—venatores ordinis certo lampam olei perscrutabuntur ante usum, cum non semper sub strenua eorum custodia esset.

source: In Morora, Lumian didn’t worry that using Mr. K’s finger this way would be detected.
target: In Morora, Lumian non timuit ne usus digitum Domini K hoc modo detegeretur.

source: Looking at the blood‐stained lump, Lumian reluctantly scooped a bit of the semi‐solid, yellowish‐red substance from his corpse wax candle and smeared it on the lump.
target: Aspiciens nodule sanguine maculatum, Lumian vix nolens paululum substantiae semi-solidae, luteo-rubrae ex candela cera cadaverum sumpsit et in nodulum unxit.

source: A double disguise, combined with a higher‐Sequence, godhood‐possessing item, should fool the Hunters’ noses and eyes!
target: Identitas duplicata, coniuncta cum suprema sequentia atque deitate praeditum, debet nasos et oculos Venatorum fallere!

source: Once the lump was coated with the yellowish‐red substance, Lumian examined the candle, reassuring himself, “Just a little bit, it shouldn’t affect the number of uses…”
target: Postquam nodule substantia luteo-rubra coopertum est, Lumian candelam perspexit, seque consolans, “Paululum tantum; numerum usuum non afficiet...”

source: After putting away the corpse wax candle, Lumian picked up the oil lamp, removed the wick made of woven black hair, and carefully submerged the yellowish‐red lump into the semi‐solid grease, ensuring it stayed in the desired position.
target: Postquam candela ex cera cadaverum reponita est, Lumian lampam olei sustulit, plicam ex capillis nigris textis removit, et caute nodule luteo-rubrum in unguente semi-solido demersiit, curans ut in loco optato remaneret.

source: Seeing the lump’s yellowish‐red color blend with the surrounding grease, leaving only faint traces hidden inside, Lumian breathed in relief and slowly inserted the wick back into the semi‐solid grease.
target: Videntes colorem luteo-rubrum noduli cum unguente circumstanti miscere, solummodo levia vestigia intus latere, Lumian leviter anhelavit et paulatim plicam in unguente semi-solido reinsertit.

source: After several adjustments, the wick’s position and condition finally met Lumian’s requirements.
target: Post aliquot adaptationes, positio et condicio plicae tandem exigentias Lumiani occurrerunt.

source: He could already imagine the scene:
target: Iam scaenam imaginari poterat:

source: The oil lamp would initially burn normally, with the corpse wax having perhaps a hint of godhood, enhancing the ritual’s effect and immersing the Iron and Blood Cross Order members in the sensory experience.
target: Lampada olei initio normale ardebit, cum cera cadaverum fortasse aliquod deitate indicium habens, effectum rituum confirmans atque membra Ordinis Crucis Ferri et Sanguinis in experientia sensoria immergens.

source: This would last for twenty or thirty seconds, after which the corpse wax part would burn.
target: Hoc per viginti aut triginta secundos manebit, deinde pars cerae cadaverum ardebit.

source: This would bring an intense pact‐like experience, potentially fatal for some Order members with weaker wills.
target: Hoc afferet experientiam vehementem, quasi pacto similem, quae fortasse fatalis erit quibusdam membris Ordinis infirmae voluntatis.

source: Of course, this might also benefit some members, causing positive mutations, but the corpse wax portion was minimal, and the burn would soon reach the random materials wrapped in Mr. K’s flesh.
target: Certe, hoc etiam quibusdam membris prodesset, mutationes positivas generans, sed pars cerae cadaverum minima fuit, et ignis mox perveniret ad materias fortuitas in carne Domini K involutas.

source: Lumian wasn’t sure what the impact would be, but he was confident it would worsen the situation.
target: Lumian non erat certus qualis effectus futuros esset, sed confidebat rem peioraturam fore.

source: Just suck on this one; it hits strong.
target: Accipe hoc; percutit vehementer.

source: Lumian recalled how South Continent people described East Balam cigarettes, smiling as he addressed the imaginary Order members.
target: Lumian meminit quomodo populi Continenti Australis cigarettas Balam orientales describerent, subridente dum ad fictos ordinis membra loquebatur.

source: Then, he cleaned up the traces on the oil lamp and tidied the scattered rubble.
target: Tum vestigia in lampade olei purgavit et ruinas dispersas ordinavit.

source: Following the faint scent of various perfumes, Lumian found his way back to the basement crack through the dense fog, leaving the area slowly.
target: Sequens tenue odor variorum unguentorum, Lumian viam suam ad fissuram subterraneam per densam nebula invenit, regionem lente relinquens.

source: He transformed into a shadow creature, silently returned to the Carnivore bar, and pretended to sleep to avoid an ambush by Albus Medici, Gusain, and others.
target: In creaturam umbram transformatus, tacite ad tabernam Carnivorum rediit, et dormire simulavit, ut insidiam a Albo Medici, Gusain, aliisque vitaret.

source: At six in the morning, Lumian felt refreshed.
target: Hora sexta matutina, Lumian se refectum sensit.

source: He rolled out of bed, stretched his neck, and laughed softly.
target: Ex lecto se evolvit, collum protraxit, et leniter risit.

source: “Didn’t come? Albus and the others didn’t come, neither did Wanak.
target: “Non venerunt? Albus et ceteri non venerunt, nec Wanak.

source: Do they think I have teleportation abilities, making it hard to kill me outside a special battlefield or without special items?
target: Putantne me facultates teleportationis habere, ita ut difficile sit me extra certum campum aut sine instrumentis specialibus interficere?

source: “Heh heh, you’re too hesitant, too cautious.
target: Heh heh, es nimis dubius, nimis cautus.

source: Now I have shadows again, no longer afraid of sunlight, and can block another fatal attack…”
target: Nunc umbras iterum habeo, iam non sole metuens, et aliam fatalem impetum obstruere possum...

source: Lumian drew the curtains, gazing at the brightening dawn, his eyes falling on the books from the Church of Knowledge on his desk.
target: Lumian cortinas trahebat, auroram fulgentem intuebatur, et oculi eius in libris Ecclesiae Scientiae super mensam eius inciderunt.

source: He instinctively felt a headache, frowning.
target: Instinctu sensit dolorem capitis et fronte contraxit.

source: He resisted reading and learning, struggling with an indescribable inner turmoil.
target: Legere et discere repugnavit, certans cum intimo inenarrabili tumultu.

source: If there were only a few books, Lumian would be highly motivated, reading diligently and focusing intently, but knowing there were three whole shelves of books and thousands of scrolls left him feeling defeated, unwilling to start.
target: Si paucos tantum libros haberet, Lumian valde incitaretur, diligenter legens atque intentissime intendens, sed sciebat tres totas cellas librorum et milia voluminum esse, quod eum victum sentire et incipere velle impediit.

source: After several seconds, Lumian rubbed his temples, sighed, and muttered to himself,
target: Post aliquot secundos, Lumian tempora sua friccavit, suspiravit, et sibi murmurat.

source: Well, since 0-01 was sealed by the Church of Knowledge, I should respect knowledge.
target: Bene, cum 0-01 a Ecclesia Scientiae sigillatum esset, scientiam honorare debeo.

source: There’s nothing else to do now, just waiting for Albus and Julie to take further action, hoping to seize an opportunity and direction…
target: Nullo alio nunc agendo, solum expectans ut Albus et Iulia ulteriora caperent, spem habens occasione et viae apprehensione...

source: Lumian sat down, leaning back in his chair, placing his feet on the edge of the desk, reading the books specified by Heraberg in a comfortable but precarious position.
target: Lumian consedit, in sella sua recubans, pedes in margine mensae ponens, libros a Heraberg indicatos legens in positione commoda sed periculosa.

source: He had read the first two or three chapters before and found nothing noteworthy, but this time he planned to study in depth.
target: Prius duas vel tres capita legebat et nihil notabile inveniit, sed hoc tempore consilium habuit diligenter studere.

source: As he read, Lumian’s expression gradually changed.
target: Dum legebat, vultus Lumiani paulatim mutatus est.

source: He became engrossed in the reading, almost forgetting the time until Lez knocked on the door, telling him breakfast was ready.
target: In lectione absorptus est, tempus paene oblitus, donec Lez ad ianuam pulsavit, nuntians eum prandium paratum esse.

source: “Okay.” Lumian nodded, setting down the book without any visible changes and heading out of the room.
target: “Bene.” Lumian annuit, librum deponens sine ullis signis mutationis, et ex conclavi proficiscens.

source: Almost at the door, he saw Lez turning towards the stairs and half-turned back, glancing at the books on the desk with a puzzled expression.
target: Fere ad ianuam, vidit Lez versus scalas convertentem et paulo retrorsum, libros super mensam intuens vultu perplexo.

source: These books indeed contained important knowledge!
target: Hi libri re vera notitiam magni momenti continebant!

source: He was currently reading one thoroughly and had skimmed through the others, already finding similarities with the details in the 0-01 sealing information, along with more detailed explanations!
target: Nunc unum penitus legebat et reliquos perlegit, iam similitudines cum rebus in notitia sigillationis 0-01 reperiens, atque etiam explicationes minutiores!

source: If I read through the three bookshelves and pass the exam, I might find a way to approach 0-01 through the overall sealing operation and use the sealing principles to protect myself when touching the artifact…
target: Si per tres cellas librorum perlegam et examen superemero, fortasse viam inveniam ad 0-01 per totam operationem sigillationis accessendum, atque principia sigillationis ad me protegendum, dum artefactum tingo.

source: Knowledge is power, knowledge is wealth, knowledge holds all the answers…
target: Scientia est potentia, scientia est divitiae, scientia omnia responsa continet...

source: Lumian withdrew his gaze, his eyes flashing with thoughts as he entered the hallway and turned towards the stairs.
target: Lumian oculos aversus, et cum cogitationibus micantibus, in vestibulum intransiit atque ad scalas vertit.

source: The problem now was that this kind of knowledge brought noticeable corruption, just like the 0-01 sealing information.
target: Quaestio nunc erat quod talis scientia corruptionem conspicuiorem afferebat, sicut notitia sigillationis 0-01.

source: Lumian worried that the more he learned, the closer he got to 0-01, the more likely he would become its puppet.
target: Lumian timebat, quo magis disceret, eo propius ad 0-01 accederet, et tanto magis ut quasi eius marionetta fieret.

source: Also, if I focus too much on reading these books, Albus, Julie, Gusain, and Wanak might get suspicious and also borrow a few books from the Church of Knowledge.
target: Etiam, si nimis in his libris legendo incumbam, Albus, Iulia, Gusain, atque Wanak suspicari possint et pauca de libris Ecclesiae Scientiae mutuo capere.

source: Then I would lose my advantage… I need to wander aimlessly every day, set traps for them, outsmart them, and make it seem like I’m just reading out of boredom…
target: Tum commoda mea amitterem… Cotidie sine proposito vagari debeo, laqueos illis ponere, eos callide superare, et efficere ut videatur me simpliciter ex taedio legere…

source: Lumian’s smile gradually widened.
target: Risus Lumiani paulatim latius factus est.

source: He finished the flight of stairs and glanced at Julie sitting on a bar stool at the counter.
target: Ille scalas perambulavit finivit atque Iuliam, quae in scabello ad mensam sedebat, intuebatur.

source: The Demoness wore a white shirt and black skirt, looking quite demure, but she swayed her waist gently, making the stool spin.
target: Daemonissa induta erat camisā albā et paenulā nigra, aspectu satis modesta, sed lumbos leniter movebat, faciens scabellum vertere.

source: She glanced back at Lumian and continued talking to Lez,
target: Illa retro ad Lumian intuebatur et ad Lez loqui continuavit,

source: “I only think about finding what I lost from other men when I’m in a terrible mood.
target: “Cogito solum de inveniendis, quae a ceteris viris amiserim, cum in animo terribili versor.

source: Normally, I just feel jealous and resentful, wondering why I lost it and they still have it?
target: Normaliter, solum invidiam et rancorem sentio, mirans cur id amiserim et illi adhuc tenerent?

source: “And you, your cooking has conquered me.
target: “Et tu, tua coquina me vicit.

source: I acknowledge your right to keep that thing, as long as you don’t come to me when I’m in a bad mood, I won’t do anything to you.”
target: Agnovero ius tuum illud retinendi, dummodo, cum in malo animo sim, ad me non accedas, nihil tibi faciam.

source: Is that why you Demonesses like turning lovers into Witches?
target: Num propter hoc, daemonissae, amatores in magas convertere libet?

source: Lumian sat beside Julie, smiling at Lez.
target: Lumian iuxta Iuliam sedebat, Lez subridens.

source: “What are you guys talking about?”
target: “De quo loquimini?”

source: Lez licked his lips and replied, “She asked if I was curious about the taste of Demoness meat and cut a small piece for me.
target: Lez labra lambebat et respondit: “Rogavit an me curiosum esse de sapore carnis daemonissae, et mihi parvum fragmentum secavit.

source: Grilled, it was delicious, rich in fat and very chewy.
target: Assatum, sapidum erat, pingue et valde masticabile.

source: Then we got to the topic we were discussing.
target: Deinde ad rem de qua disputabamus pervenimus.

source: Lumian glanced at Julie and noticed the bandage marks on her left shoulder, with some bloodstains on her shirt.
target: Lumian Iuliam intuebatur et animadvertit vestigia ligaminum in humero sinistro eius, cum quaedam sanguinis maculae in veste eius erant.

source: She really cut it… One daring to cut and the other daring to cook, your mental states and inner worlds are beyond me…
target: Vere illam secuit… Unus audax ad secandum et alter audax ad coquendum, mentes vestras atque intima regna mihi inaccessa sunt…

source: Lumian snorted and directly asked Julie, “What are you up to?”
target: Lumian sufflans directe Iuliam rogavit: “Quid agis?”

source: Julie smiled, showing two shallow dimples.
target: Iulia subridens duas parvas concavas in vultu ostendit.

source: “I want to learn cooking from Lez.”
target: “Volo a Lez artem coquendi discere.”

source: Her face was full of longing and expectation.
target: Vultus eius desiderio atque exspectatione plenus erat.

source: To cook for Celeste? You Demonesses… Lumian shook his head and focused on his breakfast.
target: Coquere pro Celeste? Vos, daemonissae… Lumian caput concussit et ad prandium suum attendit.

source: Trier, Quartier de la Cathédrale Commémorative, Apartment 702, 9 Rue Orosai.
target: Trier, Quartiere Cathedralis Commemorativus, Apartmentum 702, 9 Via Orosai.

source: Franca received a reply from Madam Judgment.
target: Franca responsum a Domina Iudicio accepit.

source: The letter began:
target: Epistula incipiebat:

source: “Mr. Star agrees to provide potion formulas and Beyonder ingredients in stages for Amandina’s matter, but he doesn’t need money or resources.
target: “Dominus Star consentit potionum formulas et ingredientes Beyonder gradatim pro re Amandina tradere, sed neque pecuniam neque opes requirit.

source: He only hopes you can help with some matters.”
target: Sperat tantum te posse in quibusdam rebus auxilium praestare.
